mapper.select: select d.device_code , d.height , d.longitude , d.latitude , d.site_code , t.model_id , d.model_code mfgr_code , t.device_model_code , t.device_type , t.pic_sensor_size , t.pic_sensor_length , t.pic_sensor_width , ifnull(t.min_focus,'1') as min_focus , t.focus_range , t.horiz_view_range , t.verti_view_range , t.horiz_range , t.verti_range , ifnull(t.verti_down_neg,'0') as verti_down_neg , t.remark , '3' as visual_range , dp.real_hor_angle as pan , dp.real_pitch_angle as tilt from vm_device_info_t d left join vm_device_model_t t on d.device_model_code = t.device_model_code and d.model_code = t.mfgr_code left join vm_device_ref_point_valid_t dp on d.device_code = dp.device_code and dp.point_flag = '1' where d.device_code = #{deviceCode} limit 1

SELECT min(o.channel_code) as channel_code, d.device_code, d.height, d.longitude, d.latitude, d.site_code, t.model_id, t.mfgr_code, t.device_model_code, t.device_type, t.pic_sensor_size, t.pic_sensor_length, t.pic_sensor_width, ifnull(t.min_focus,'1') as min_focus, t.focus_range, t.horiz_view_range, t.verti_view_range, t.horiz_range, t.verti_range, ifnull(t.verti_down_neg,'0') as verti_down_neg, t.remark, '3' AS visual_range, dp.real_hor_angle AS pan, dp.real_pitch_angle AS tilt, ST_DISTANCE ( POINT (#{pointLon},#{pointLat}), POINT ( d.longitude, d.latitude ) ) * 111195 AS distance FROM vm_order_devices o, vm_device_info_t d LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t t ON d.device_model_code = t.device_model_code AND d.model_code = t.mfgr_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_ref_point_valid_t dp ON d.device_code = dp.device_code AND dp.point_flag = '1' WHERE o.tenant_id = #{customerCode} AND ST_DISTANCE ( POINT (#{pointLon},#{pointLat}), POINT ( d.longitude, d.latitude ) ) * 111195 <= #{focusLimit} AND d.latitude IS NOT NULL AND d.site_code IS NOT NULL group by d.device_code, d.height, d.longitude, d.latitude, d.site_code, t.model_id, t.mfgr_code, t.device_model_code, t.device_type, t.pic_sensor_size, t.pic_sensor_length, t.pic_sensor_width, ifnull(t.min_focus,'1'), t.focus_range, t.horiz_view_range, t.verti_view_range, t.horiz_range, t.verti_range, ifnull(t.verti_down_neg,'0'), t.remark, dp.real_hor_angle, dp.real_pitch_angle, d.longitude, d.latitude

SELECT pan,hor_offset as "horOffset",pitch_offset as "pitchOffset",real_hor_angle,real_pitch_angle FROM vm_device_ref_point_valid_t where device_code = #{deviceCode} and point_flag = '1' order by pan asc

SELECT pan,hor_offset as "horOffset",pitch_offset as "pitchOffset",real_hor_angle,real_pitch_angle FROM vm_device_ref_point_valid_t where device_code = #{deviceCode} and point_flag = '1' order by real_hor_angle asc

SELECT CAST(AVG(hor_offset) as decimal(10,2)) as "horOffset",CAST(avg(pitch_offset) as decimal(10,2)) as "pitchOffset" FROM vm_device_ref_point_valid_t where device_code = #{deviceCode} and point_flag = '1'

select d.device_code , d.device_name , d.device_status , d.height , d.longitude , d.latitude , d.site_code , t.model_id , t.mfgr_code , t.device_model_code , t.device_type , t.pic_sensor_size , t.pic_sensor_length , t.pic_sensor_width , t.min_focus , t.focus_range , t.horiz_view_range , t.verti_view_range , t.horiz_range , t.verti_range , t.verti_down_neg , t.remark , CAST(d.visual_radius AS CHAR)/1000 as visual_range , dp.point_id , dp.hor_offset , dp.pitch_offset , dp.pan from vm_device_info_t d left join vm_device_model_t t on d.device_model_code = t.device_model_code and d.model_code = t.mfgr_code left join vm_device_ref_point_valid_t dp on d.device_code = dp.device_code and dp.point_flag = '1' where d.device_code = #{deviceCode} order by dp.pan
